parameters.name: AcwCookieStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the tracking cookie switch.

- **0**: disabled.

- **1 (default)**: enabled.

parameters.name: AcwSecureStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the secure attribute of the tracking cookie.

- **0 (default)**: disabled.

- **1**: enabled.

parameters.name: AcwV3SecureStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the secure attribute of the slider cookie.

- **0 (default)**: disabled.

- **1**: enabled.

parameters.name: CustomHeaders
parameters.description:
The list of specified header fields.

> The first IP address in the specified header field is used as the client source IP address to prevent XFF spoofing. If multiple headers are specified, the system attempts to obtain the source IP address from the headers in order. If the first header does not contain an IP address, the system tries the second header, and so on. If none of the specified headers contain an IP address, the first IP address in the X-Forwarded-For header is used.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description:
The name of the protected object.

> The protected object must have been added to WAF. You can call the [DescribeDefenseResources](~~461612~~) operation to query the name of the protected object.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the custom response header.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the custom response header.

parameters.name: XffStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether a Layer 7 proxy (Anti-DDoS Pro, CDN, or similar) is deployed in front of WAF. Valid values:

- **0 (default)**: No Layer 7 proxy is deployed.

- **1**: A Layer 7 proxy is deployed.
